telegram.step1: Open <mono>@BotFather</mono> in Telegram, send <mono>/newbot</mono> and paste the token it gives you in Bot token above.
telegram.step2: Save. The bot starts within a few seconds and its commands (listed below) are set automatically, no need for <mono>/setcommands</mono>.
telegram.step3: Add your Telegram user ID to Allowed users. To find it, message <mono>@userinfobot</mono>, or write to the bot in private: while you are not on the list, it replies with your ID.
telegram.step4: Optional, for notifications in a group: put the group ID in Notification chat. Left empty, notifications go to the private chat with the first allowed user.
telegram.step5: For one topic per project: create a group with Topics (forum) enabled, add the bot as an administrator, put the group ID in Notification chat, create a topic for each project and save the topic ID (message_thread_id, the last number in the link of a message from the topic) in the project settings.
telegram.transcriptionDescription: Voice messages are transcribed with OpenAI, so they need the OpenAI key.
